terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that apply when you use Visa Expeditor.

s1.heading: Agreement to these terms
s1.body: By using this website you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site. These terms are a draft and are pending review by qualified counsel.

s2.heading: What we do
s2.body: Visa Expeditor provides document preparation and application assistance for passports, visas and immigration paperwork. We are not a government agency and we are not a law firm.

s3.heading: No legal advice
s3.body: We do not provide legal advice. Information on this site is general and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified professional.

s4.heading: Your responsibilities
s4.body: You agree to provide accurate information and genuine documents, and to meet the requirements set by the relevant authorities.

s5.heading: Fees and payments
s5.body: Government fees are paid to the official authority and are separate from any service fee. Any service fee will be shown to you before you commit.

s6.heading: Limitation of liability
s6.body: We help you prepare applications but we do not control the decisions of authorities. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for outcomes decided by others.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.description: How we handle the information you share with us.

s1.heading: What we collect
s1.body: We collect the information you give us through our forms, such as your name, email, optional phone number, passport country, destination, travel dates and message.

s2.heading: How we use it
s2.body: We use your information to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you ask for.

s3.heading: Legal basis
s3.body: Where required, we process personal data on the basis of your consent, our contract with you, or our legitimate interests. This section is a draft pending review.

s4.heading: Sharing
s4.body: We share information only with service providers who help us operate the site and respond to you, or where the law requires it.

s5.heading: Retention and your rights
s5.body: We keep information only as long as we need it, and you can ask us to access, correct or delete it. Your rights vary by jurisdiction.

s6.heading: Contact
s6.body: Use the contact form to reach us about privacy, and we will respond as soon as we can.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Important limits on the information we provide.

s1.heading: General information only
s1.body: Content on this site is general information, not advice for your specific situation.

s2.heading: Not a government agency
s2.body: We are not affiliated with any government agency, consulate or embassy.

s3.heading: Not a law firm
s3.body: We are not a law firm and we do not provide legal advice.

s4.heading: Accuracy
s4.body: Rules change often. Always confirm requirements with official sources before you travel or apply.

s5.heading: No guarantees
s5.body: We do not guarantee approval of any application, visa or entry.

s6.heading: Third-party links
s6.body: Links to third-party sites are provided for convenience, and we are not responsible for their content.

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.description: How and why we use cookies on this site.

s1.heading: What cookies are
s1.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help websites work and remember your choices.

s2.heading: Essential cookies
s2.body: Some cookies are necessary for the site to work, such as remembering your language and passport selection.

s3.heading: Analytics cookies
s3.body: With your consent, we may use analytics cookies to understand how the site is used. We do not load them before you consent.

s4.heading: Managing cookies
s4.body: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the cookie banner or your browser settings.

s5.heading: Third parties
s5.body: Where we use third-party tools, they may set their own cookies, subject to their own policies.

s6.heading: Updates
s6.body: This notice is a draft and may change after legal review.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: Our approach to making this site usable for everyone.

s1.heading: Our commitment
s1.body: We want this site to be usable by as many people as possible, including people who use assistive technology.

s2.heading: Standards we aim for
s2.body: We aim to follow widely recognized accessibility guidelines, including keyboard navigation and sufficient color contrast.

s3.heading: Known limitations
s3.body: Some older content may not yet fully meet our target. We are working through it.

s4.heading: Feedback
s4.body: If you meet a barrier, contact us and tell us what happened so we can improve.

s5.heading: Assistive technology
s5.body: We test with common screen readers and keyboard-only navigation, and we continue to refine the site.

s6.heading: Contact
s6.body: Use the contact form to reach us about accessibility.
